summary: HNI Corp filed an 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement: Amendment No. 3 to its Credit Agreement, dated June 10, 2026, providing a new $498.75 million tranche of term loans maturing in 2032 to refinance outstanding Initial Tranche B Term Loans. The amendment sets applicable rates at 1.75% for SOFR loans and 0.75% for Alternate Base Rate loans, with a 1.00% per annum amortization. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other corporate action is involved.
